dict.string: macos-data needs Contacts access to read and manage your iCloud contacts from the local CLI.
macos-data needs full Calendar access to query and explicitly manage events in your iCloud calendars.
macos-data needs full Reminders access to query and explicitly manage reminders in your iCloud lists.
macos-data needs Photos access to query photo and album metadata and to export only explicitly requested assets.
macos-data uses Apple Events only for explicitly requested Mail.app, Notes.app, and Shortcuts operations.
